name: IconSnake
tagline: 把已安装 App 的图标变成主屏幕上的贪吃蛇。
description: 图标贪吃蛇让你直接在主屏幕上玩贪吃蛇，蛇身和食物均由设备中已安装 App 的图标组成。
游戏会随得分逐渐加速，结束后可以再次游玩或恢复原主屏幕。
notice: 🎮 长按主屏幕底部的 Search 按钮或页面指示器开始游戏；在屏幕任意位置滑动即可改变方向。
features: 使用全部可启动且具有可见图标的已安装 App
在主屏幕上直接开始游戏
全屏滑动转向并随得分逐渐加速
图标耗尽后可选择胜利或重新洗牌继续
游戏结束后可重开或恢复主屏幕
支持 English、简体中文和繁體中文
usage: 安装后打开“设置”中的图标贪吃蛇，确认总开关已启用。
选择图标耗尽后直接胜利或重新洗牌继续。
返回主屏幕，长按底部 Search 按钮或页面指示器开始游戏。
在屏幕任意位置滑动改变方向。

changes: 新增使用全部已安装 App 图标游玩主屏幕贪吃蛇。
新增图标耗尽后胜利或重新洗牌继续的选项。
修复长按启动可能进入主屏幕编辑模式的问题，并增强启动可靠性。

en.name: IconSnake
en.tagline: Turn installed app icons into a Snake game on your Home Screen.
description: IconSnake lets you play Snake directly on the Home Screen, using icons from installed apps as the snake and food.
The game gradually speeds up with your score, and you can play again or restore the original Home Screen when it ends.
en.notice: 🎮 Long-press the Search button or page indicator at the bottom of the Home Screen to start. Swipe anywhere to change direction.
features: Use all launchable installed apps with visible icons
Start and play directly on the Home Screen
Swipe anywhere to turn while speed increases with score
Win or reshuffle and continue when the icon pool runs out
Play again or restore the Home Screen after a game
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
usage: Open IconSnake in Settings after installation and make sure it is enabled.
Choose whether an exhausted icon pool should end in a win or reshuffle and continue.
Return to the Home Screen and long-press the Search button or page indicator to start.
Swipe anywhere on the screen to change direction.

changes: Added a Home Screen Snake game using icons from all installed apps.
Added options to win or reshuffle and continue when the icon pool runs out.
Fixed long-press activation entering Home Screen edit mode and improved launch reliability.
